terms.gloss: a likeness, a pattern; here, a model in AI
evidence: Cic. Lael. 23: tamquam exemplar aliquod intuētur suī, of a true friend as an image of oneself (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically a copy, an image or likeness, and a pattern (Lewis & Short; see model, someone or something to copy). A model in AI is a likeness built from data of how language or pictures go, so the word fits its classical senses; its use here is modern, and ours. A language model is exemplar linguae.

phrases.latin: Hoc exemplar ex librīs innumerābilibus didicit.
phrases.english: This model learned from countless books.
